title: Normal_1
extract_protocol_ch1: Fresh CC tissue samples of about 1×1-cm size were first immersed in 15 ml PBS with vigorous shaking to remove residual blood cells. Then, tissues were cut into pieces of 1×1-mm size and enzymatically digested with 2.5 mg/ml collagenase type I (17104-019, gibco), 4 mg/ml collagenase type IV (17018029, gibco), 0.1 mg/ml neutral protease, and 2 mg/ml DNase I (#AMPD1, Sigma-Aldrich) at 37°C for 40 min. Subsequently, the cell suspension was filtered through a 40-mm nylon mesh, and the cells were sorted by MACS with a Dead Cell Removal Kit (130-090-101, Miltenyi Biotec) to remove dead cells. The cells were resuspended in 0.05% BSA/PBS buffer before 10× Genomics library preparation.
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Single-cell RNA-seq libraries were prepared using the Chromium Single Cell 3′ Library & Gel Bead Kit v3 (PN-1000094, 10× Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Final libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000.
data_processing: The raw sequencing reads were processed by Cell Ranger (v.3.1.0) with the default parameters. The reference genome was GRh38-1.2.0.
data_processing.2: Supplementary files format and content: matrix files
contact_institute: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine
